kind: offline, existing records only, no robot, no new data
question: Option B = routine generator stays the collection model (ldp_jit e100) + corrector; when the stall rule fires, candidates of the retrained model (ldp_tkL e100) are added to the pool. Does ldp_tkL (1) supply leaving candidates at wrong-socket stalls it has NOT been trained on, and (2) stay quiet at right-socket stalls, so that adding its candidates is useful without a selector?

scenes.W_unseen: wrong socket, not in ldp_tkL training: 6 held-out LEAVE take-overs at handoff_step-1 (3 wrong +y, 3 wrong -y) + the 2 tonight runs of jit+corrector stuck at wrong +y (ep 210725, 210845; steps 400, 650, 890; a run counts once, with its mean share)
scenes.R: right socket, collection model stalled: all valid ALIGN take-overs at handoff_step-1 (31; none in ldp_tkL training)

measure: per scene 8 seeds (100..107) x 16 candidates = 128; a candidate lifts if mean unnormalized z command over its first 12 steps > 0.06 (same definition as 5090 diag_leave manyk.py). scene share = lifting / 128. A scene 'has supply' if share >= 1/16 (one expected per 16 drawn).
already_known_before_freeze: 5090 manyk_tkL100.json: held LEAVE lifting of 128 = +y 0, 3, 128; -y 0, 128, 0 (so 2 of 6 have supply). 5090 offline check: ldp_tkL lifted all 16 at 1 of 6 held ALIGN scenes. New here: all 31 ALIGN scenes at 128 candidates, tonight's corrector-on stalls with ldp_tkL, AUROC.

criteria.P1_supply: share of W_unseen scenes (8) with supply >= 0.50
criteria.P2_quiet: share of R scenes (31) with supply <= 0.20
criteria.P3_separation: AUROC of scene share, W_unseen vs R >= 0.75

verdict.B_NEEDS_SELECTOR: P1 passes, P2 or P3 fails (candidates exist but also at the right socket: something must choose)

predictions.P1: fail or borderline: 3 of 8 (2 of 6 known + 1 of 2 tonight runs)
predictions.P2: fail: about 30 % of right-socket scenes have supply
predictions.jit reference: supply in <= 1 W_unseen scene and <= 2 R scenes

limits: 8 unseen wrong scenes; one training seed per model; candidates only (no execution of a leaving plan from a state reached by the other generator); stalls in runs that succeeded alone are not included; no Q exists for the real robot yet.
no_rerun_rule: no change of definitions or thresholds after results
